title: Five real packing recordings: development study
type: development observations, not a held-out benchmark
scope: One person, one workspace, one reference, five attempts. These recordings informed fixes. They were processed across different builds; expected scenarios were not frozen in the independent trial system. No accuracy percentage is claimed. A later run on one build, recorded in single_build_run, is also development evidence.
remaining_limit: Boxes are 2D, so a covered item is inferred from its confirmed placement and the covering object's position, not observed directly. The earlier result for these attempts is kept in fresh_post_fix_assessment.

cases.expected_behavior: Accept if all required evidence is visible
cases.observation: The original result exposed containment and tracking errors. Fresh inference after the fixes verifies the visible placements; the covered final cube still requires review.
